scope: Prospective one-second periodic small-motion validation case; no rest-start/transient claim

sea.kind: controlled three-component directional sea; not an observed buoy realization

comparison.rotation_error_chart: theta=Log(R*R_equilibrium^T), components in mean world axes; compare the same chart in both models
comparison.reference_uncertainty: Sum over forcing components of max(abs(H4-H3),abs(H3-H2))*incident amplitude, componentwise in physical DOF units; empirical spatial envelope only
comparison.reference_acceptance: Both finest increments fit the allocated motion budget, and latest componentwise increment <= previous + roundoff floor; all complex component phases retained
comparison.comparison_acceptance: Actual Topwater-minus-reference motion error plus independently estimated reference/comparison uncertainty <= full per-axis motion limit; reference allocation does not waive other uncertainty sources

initialization.kind: periodic steady state with prehistory extending before t=0
initialization.body: Mean equilibrium plus reconstructed generalized displacement; exact exponential rotation map about mean world axes; velocity derived consistently
initialization.fluid: Total incident+diffraction+radiation periodic surface elevation/potential at t=0, pulled from the mean plane to the nonlinear surface and projected onto the current body Neumann condition
initialization.compatibility: Periodic prehistory is exact only for the linear reference; nonlinear compatibility projection may launch adjustment transients. Projection, sampling and nonlinear representation errors must be measured and charged; body-only initialization is insufficient
initialization.runtime_boundary_forcing: Analytic prescribed incident waves only; no future Capytaine body trajectory, pressure or force injection

amplitude_controls.purpose: Check approach to linear limit and wetting changes without changing the frozen full-amplitude comparison case after judging Topwater

raw_reference.original_decision: unqualified under original coefficient policy; never relabeled
raw_reference.periodic_field_data_status: not exported; blocks complete initial-state/reference qualification
